novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is a combined mechanism/measurement hypothesis: jailbreaks and borderline prompts allegedly occupy a “low-certainty band,” measured through “distance/margin to the refusal decision boundary” and “local curvature/instability of the refusal projection.” Searches around “LLM jailbreak refusal loss landscape smoothness,” “refusal direction decision boundary margin,” and “activation uncertainty jailbreak detection” identify Gradient Cuff (NeurIPS 2024), which already detects jailbreaks using refusal-loss values and landscape smoothness, while Arditi et al. (NeurIPS 2024), RASS (EMNLP 2025), and AlignTree (AAAI 2025) respectively establish refusal-direction geometry, boundary-region over-refusal, and activation-based jailbreak monitoring. Moving to uncertainty defined by the margin and perturbation stability of the internal refusal projection—and unifying jailbreak and over-refusal cases—is a natural extension and modest synthesis of those lines rather than a new core relationship or measurement paradigm.
